scope: Broaden the current DWG/DXF peer review across MLINESTYLE graph closure, FreeCAD's converter selection/fallback path, and the local writer; update existing implementation gates without duplicating findings or promoting support.

evidenceKinds: FreeCAD public issue and merged pull-request reports
read-only local source and plan audit
method.evidenceRule: Issue reports and unpinned application behavior are test leads only. A source-only candidate mismatch is not a local defect until a generated local output is captured and checked against an applicable primary contract and exact consumer profile.

evidence.topic: MLINESTYLE is a cross-section name/object/owner graph, not one header field
observations: The HEADER variable $CMLSTYLE is the current multiline-style name, not a handle.
An MLINESTYLE object is owned by the ACAD_MLINESTYLE named-object dictionary entry.
An MLINE has both a redundant style name in group 2 and a handle reference in group 340; Autodesk says the referenced style must be in the MLINESTYLE dictionary.
The reviewed pages do not establish that every drawing without MLINE entities must contain a default Standard object.
evidence.planAction: Extend existing f.4b.1b generated tests to assert the header name, root dictionary entry, object owner, MLINE identity/name/pointer and output-handle mapping independently. Keep the no-style/default policy open pending target-specific primary/consumer evidence.

evidence.topic: FreeCAD dangling-$CMLSTYLE report and merged repair
observations: Issue #31836 reports FreeCAD R12/R14 DXF output carrying $CMLSTYLE=STANDARD without an ACAD_MLINESTYLE dictionary; the reporter states LibreDWG 0.14 dxf2dwg refused the file with a misleading Out of memory message and succeeded after only that variable was removed.
PR #31896 merged as commit 3389881, removing the header variable from two FreeCAD header templates.
The PR's proposed regression test was removed before merge at maintainer request, so the merge is not a continuing regression-test guarantee.
The issue says later LibreDWG master tolerated the absent dictionary; this review did not pin or run that source, and does not transfer the behavior to a released build or normative DXF policy.
limits: This is a FreeCAD exporter report, not a reproduction against libdxfrw output.
The reported profile is R12/R14 and does not determine modern-target libdxfrw behavior.
LibreDWG's error string is not sufficient to diagnose a local failure.
evidence.planAction: Use the report as a generated graph-closure test lead, not as authorization to copy the R12/R14 omission. Pin any optional LibreDWG executable and inspect actual output and strict reopen.

observations: The open issue reports that FreeCAD 1.1.3's Automatic DXF-to-DWG route can return the first converter's intended output path without verifying it exists, preventing later configured converter fallback.
The reported Windows profile used LibreDWG 0.14 and ODA File Converter 27.1.0; a forced ODA route succeeded while Automatic did not reach ODA.
limits: The report is application-side, platform/version-specific and was not reproduced here.
It does not establish a libdxfrw parser or writer defect.
evidence.planAction: At the existing composed FreeCAD checkpoint, test explicit converter selection first using a fresh unique destination and capture the exact process/output. If Automatic behavior itself is in scope, separate it into its own receipt cell and verify fallback after failure; stale or absent output is never success.

evidence.topic: Local source candidate requiring a generated output check
localEvidence: src/drw_header.cpp: DRW_Header::write emits $CMLSTYLE for post-R12 output and defaults its value to Standard.
src/libdxfrw.cpp: a low-level writeMLineStyle method exists, but source-tree references show no dwg2dxf adapter dispatch to it.
dwg2dxf/dx_iface.h: import callbacks retain MLineStyle, while current writeObjects routing does not emit its typed dictionary/object graph; the existing plan tracks this in f.4b.
limits: No generated output was captured in this research pass.
No production defect is established; source-level presence of a header default is not a strict-reader failure result.
The current plan already owns MLINESTYLE integration, so no new finding or subplan is justified.
evidence.planAction: In the existing fast DXF fixture/adapter targets, add locally generated ASCII/binary no-style, Standard-style, custom-style and MLINE closure cases with root owner, object owner, group 2/340, remap, and terminal framing assertions. Keep strict peer/native validation at the existing composed checkpoint.

existingOwners: existing DXF fixture and named-object adapter tests

implementationReadiness.composedValidation: One exact explicit-converter check after graph emission closes; Automatic fallback is a separate downstream application route.
implementationReadiness.fixturePolicy: No external DWG/DXF payload is added. Generated files remain in memory or disposable scratch space.
